reference.note: 3 reasons your business isn't making more money
reference.text: There are three reasons your business is not making as much money as you want. Number one is promotion. Number two is the product or service itself. Number three is what happens every single day inside your business. Fix those three things in that order and you will make more money.

hook_options: Shiny object syndrome is not a lack of focus, it's a lack of fortitude.
You keep starting things you never finish, and it isn't about discipline.
The real reason you quit is not what you think it is.
Three mistakes are quietly draining your bank account.
You don't have a focus problem. You have a finishing problem.

script.line: Shiny object syndrome is not a lack of focus, it's a lack of fortitude.
The first mistake is quitting the moment something feels hard instead of boring.
Second, you measure the actual cost of *not* doing it, and you never do the math.
And the third mistake is treating every new idea as evidence the old one was wrong.
Save this video so you have it the next time you want to quit.

shot_list.spoken_text: Shiny object syndrome is not a lack of focus, it's a lack of fortitude. They are subtle, but they will kill your growth and your bank account.
The first mistake is quitting the moment something feels hard instead of boring.
Second, you measure the actual cost of *not* doing it, and you never do the math.
And the third mistake is treating every new idea as evidence the old one was wrong.
Save this video so you have it the next time you want to quit.
